display.purpose: The DSIM wordmark on the home cover, once per app.

title.purpose: Secondary page headings and overlay titles.

body-lg.purpose: Lead paragraph, row names, rail labels.

body-sm.purpose: Descriptions, notes, section labels, segment values.

caption.purpose: Stat labels and the season badge.

field-callout.purpose: Field drawing labels; 4/5/6/8 are SVG user units, not screen px.

hud-data.purpose: Space Grotesk scores and timers inside .game-root.

sm.role: small buttons, segments inside a track

md.role: buttons, inputs, rail items, tracks, plain panels, stats

lg.role: cards, mode lists, Play button, results panel

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: The only chrome shadow: cards, buttons, option cards, the Play button (--ds-block).

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Selected segment, rail item, sub-nav item, start-position tab.

shadows.name: selected-ring
shadows.purpose: Chosen option card, paired with an ink border.

shadows.name: hud-edge
shadows.purpose: HUD keycap edge under pressables, inside .game-root only.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: The 1px translateY press on buttons, cards and the Play button.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, border-colour and colour changes on hover (0.14s on rail items).

motion.name: arrow-nudge
motion.purpose: Row arrows nudge 3px right on hover; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: verdict-slam
motion.purpose: Results verdict landing; the table and actions fade up 0.25s after.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one ink action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--ds-font-ui); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--ds-ink); background: var(--ds-ink); color: var(--ds-panel); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.06s ease, background 0.12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ds-ink-dim); border-color: var(--ds-ink-dim); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every other action: white, hairline, quiet.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--ds-font-ui); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--ds-line); background: var(--ds-panel); color: var(--ds-ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.06s ease, border-color 0.12s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ds-line-strong); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Play Action
components.description: The home cover's single ink block with a sub-line and a nudging arrow.
components.css: .ds-play { font-family: var(--ds-font-ui); width: 100%; max-width: 420px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; grid-template-areas: "l arrow" "h arrow"; align-items: center; column-gap: 16px; row-gap: 2px; padding: 16px 24px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--ds-ink); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ds-ink); color: var(--ds-panel); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.06s ease, background 0.12s; } .ds-play:hover { background: var(--ds-ink-dim); } .ds-play:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-play-l { grid-area: l; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-play-h { grid-area: h; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-play-arrow { grid-area: arrow; width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-play:hover .ds-play-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Mode List
components.description: A group of modes as one card; rows divided by hairlines, the recommended one marked by a honey dot.
components.css: .ds-modes { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--ds-panel); border: 1px solid var(--ds-line); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); overflow: hidden; } .ds-mode { font-family: var(--ds-font-ui); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 200px) minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 24px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ds-line); background: none; color: var(--ds-ink); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s; } .ds-mode:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-mode:hover { background: var(--ds-tile); } .ds-mode:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mode-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-mode.primary .ds-mode-name::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ds-honey); } .ds-mode-desc { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ds-mut); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Three or four equal segments on a tile track; the chosen one lifts onto the card.
components.css: .ds-segtrack { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--ds-tile); } .ds-segv { font: 600 13px/1 var(--ds-font-ui); min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ds-mut); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s, color 0.12s; } .ds-segv:hover { color: var(--ds-ink); } .ds-segv.on { background: var(--ds-panel); color: var(--ds-ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ds-line), 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); } .ds-segv:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Left rail: label over hint, tile wash on hover, lifted when current.
components.css: .ds-railnav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 196px; } .ds-railitem { font-family: var(--ds-font-ui); text-align: left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--ds-ink-dim); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.14s, color 0.14s; } .ds-railitem .rl { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-railitem .rh { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ds-mut); } .ds-railitem:hover { background: var(--ds-tile); color: var(--ds-ink); } .ds-railitem.on { background: var(--ds-panel); color: var(--ds-ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ds-line), 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); } .ds-railitem:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Option Card
components.description: Pickable preset or setting; the selected one takes an ink outline and stays white.
components.css: .ds-option { font-family: var(--ds-font-ui); text-align: left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--ds-line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--ds-panel); color: var(--ds-ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.06s ease, border-color 0.12s; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: var(--ds-line-strong); } .ds-option:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-option.on { border-color: var(--ds-ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ds-ink); } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-option .ot { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-option .od { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--ds-mut); }

components.name: Chip and Season Badge
components.description: Hairline pill for counts and status; the honey-wash badge beside the wordmark.
components.css: .ds-chipx { font: 12px/1.2 var(--ds-font-ui); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--ds-line); background: var(--ds-panel); color: var(--ds-ink); } .ds-chipx b { color: var(--ds-accent); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chipx.red { background: var(--ds-red-chip); border-color: transparent; color: #ffffff; } .ds-season { font: 600 11px/1.2 var(--ds-font-ui); letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--ds-accent-soft); color: var(--ds-accent-soft-ink); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A tile-filled field whose control-edge border is the whole control.
components.css: .ds-field-input { font: 14px/1.3 var(--ds-font-ui); color: var(--ds-ink); background: var(--ds-tile); border: 1px solid var(--ds-line-strong); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-accent); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Results Sides
components.description: The results overlay's two alliance blocks; the winner gets a honey outline, the loser is never faded.
components.css: .ds-res { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-resside { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--ds-font-ui); } .ds-resside.red { background: var(--ds-red-chip); } .ds-resside.blue { background: var(--ds-blue-chip); } .ds-resside.win { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-honey); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-resside span { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-resside strong { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
DSIM's menus are the table in the pit, not the match: a clean, well-lit surface where a driver picks a mode, sets the bots in three taps, and goes. The category standard is played straight (the Linear / Arc bar): soft cool-grey floor, white cards with hairline borders, 8 to 12px corners, a shadow you would only notice if it were missing, one type family in sentence case, and one ink button per screen that says where to go next. Everything else is quieter than that button by design.

Colour is almost absent. The interface runs on neutrals; the single accent is BIOBUZZ honey, and it is spent in small, fixed places: the logo tile, the season badge beside the wordmark, the hive cells in the field drawing, the dot marking the recommended mode. Alliance red and blue appear only where they carry identity (zone tints, results sides, alliance chips). Density is moderate: generous vertical air on the home cover, compact list rows everywhere else.

The in-match HUD is a different world on purpose. It keeps the look it was designed and contrast-audited with (green accent, Plus Jakarta Sans and Space Grotesk, 4 to 24px corners, hard offset block shadows, a pressed keycap edge), pinned in one place so the chrome's calm set never leaks into it and vice versa. The results and pause overlays are part of the menu flow and switch back to the calm set.
keyCharacteristics: Soft neutral floor (#f6f7f9 light, #0e1013 dark) with white or near-black cards bounded by a 1px hairline.
One primary action per screen, filled with ink (inverts with the theme), never with honey.
Honey is a garnish: logo, season badge, hive cells, the recommended-mode dot.
Archivo Variable for everything in the chrome, sentence case; numbers set with tabular figures rather than a second face.
Selection is shown by lifting onto the card (panel fill, 1px line ring, the ambient shadow), never by colour floods or weight changes.
Presses move by `transform` only; hovers change colour, background or border colour, never geometry.
The HUD is an explicit, token-scoped exception (`.game-root`).

rules.name: The Three Grounds Rule
rules.body: Every token belongs to one of three categories and behaves accordingly: readable-against-the-surface tokens INVERT in dark mode (ink, mut, accent, warn, danger, every `-ink`); fills with fixed ink do NOT (red/blue/green/purple, the `-chip` fills, honey, gold); tokens whose ground is the field canvas (`on-field`, `on-field-dim`, `on-field-accent`) exist only in the light block because the canvas never themes. `npm run contrast` asserts the pairs in both themes.

rules.name: The Split Ink Rule
rules.body: A colour that must work as both a fill and as text is two tokens. Use the fill for surfaces and dots, its `-ink` sibling for words.

rules.name: The Garnish Rule
rules.body: Honey appears as a small fill (a tile, a badge, a dot, a cell) and never as a button fill, a panel, or a heading colour. The primary action is ink.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: The chrome uses Archivo Variable only. Hierarchy comes from weight (500 to 800) and size; data comes from tabular figures.

rules.name: The Whole Pixel Rule
rules.body: Font sizes are whole pixels and weights come from the seven the variable cuts use (400, 500, 600, 700, 750, 800, 900). `npm run uiaudit` fails on a fractional size or an eighth weight.

rules.name: The Still Label Rule
rules.body: Selecting a segment, tab or card never changes its font weight; selection is colour, fill and ring only, so no label reflows its neighbours.

rules.name: The Four Pixel Rule
rules.body: Gap and padding sit on 0/2/4/8/12/16/24/32/48. `uiaudit` holds the remaining off-grid count as a ratchet that may only go down.

rules.name: The Barely-There Rule
rules.body: The chrome has one shadow, 1px down at 5% opacity. If a surface needs more separation, it gets a border, not a bigger shadow.

rules.name: The Transform-Only Press Rule
rules.body: Pressables sink 1px with `transform: translateY(1px)` (60ms). Hover changes colour, background or border colour; nothing gains a border width or margin. `npm run shiftaudit` enforces it in both themes.

dos: **Do** give each screen one ink primary action (`ink` fill, `panel` text) and keep every other control quieter than it.
**Do** spend honey only as a small fill: the logo tile, the season badge, hive cells, the recommended-mode dot, the winner's outline.
**Do** separate surfaces with a 1px hairline and the single ambient shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05)).
**Do** show selection by lifting onto the card (panel fill, 1px line ring, ambient shadow) or, on option cards, an ink outline.
**Do** keep type in Archivo, sentence case, on the documented ramp, with tabular figures for numbers.
**Do** keep gap and padding on the 4px grid (2px only inside chips and segmented tracks).
**Do** press with `transform: translateY(1px)` and hover with colour, background or border colour only.
**Do** put a new colour in the right ground (inverting, fixed-ink, or canvas-only) and run `npm run contrast` after any token edit.
**Do** scope anything HUD-shaped to `.game-root`, and keep overlays in the menu flow on the calm set.
donts: **Don't** fill a button, panel or heading with honey; the primary action is ink.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows, keycap edges, or Plus Jakarta Sans / Space Grotesk outside `.game-root`.
**Don't** use a raw scoring fill (red, blue, green, purple, pollen) as chrome text; use its `-ink` sibling.
**Don't** change font weight, border width or margin on hover, selection or press.
**Don't** set menu labels in tracked uppercase; the chrome is sentence case.
**Don't** introduce a second chrome accent hue; alliance red and blue appear only where they mean an alliance.
**Don't** use a fractional font size or a weight outside 400/500/600/700/750/800/900.
**Don't** reference a custom property that is not defined, or give `var()` a literal hex fallback.
